name: outbox-email-scheduler
description: Full-stack email scheduling application (Express + Redis + BullMQ + Postgres, React + TypeScript)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
